breakpoints.rationale: phone widths: 4 columns so pairs can sit side by side (2 + 2) while every text block takes the full width; 16px margin and gutter keep 343px of content at 375px

8 columns hold a 6-column text block at 50-67ch and the 5 + 3 and 3 + 3 + 2 splits the grid specimens use (4 columns could not); the frame stops at 800px so text cannot outgrow its measure before the 12-column layout takes over
12 columns from the width where a 3-column label and a 3-column aside can flank a 6-column text block; the container stops at 1280px, where 6 columns of body text still read under 75ch

regions.rationale: running label (page number, collection) hangs in the first three columns
display title starts on column 4, the page's main reading edge
20px introduction; 7 of 12 columns keeps it inside 45-75ch at that size and shares the title's start edge
section number and name hang in the first three columns, so every section starts on the same edge
explanatory prose at 16px, 48-70ch across the tablet and desktop ranges
keyboard, token and usage notes beside the prose; below it on smaller screens
component specimens share the prose column's start edge; the label column stays empty beside them
full-width grid specimens whose blocks sit on page columns through subgrid
blocks inside a grid specimen: spans differ per pattern, so only their track edges are audited
settings sections: a rail beside the form on desktop, a row of links above it below that
one form column; the two empty tracks at the end keep fields near the reading edge
page title, its primary action and the filter bar span the frame
the records workspace takes the whole frame; its rail and table use a local layout
filter rail at a functional width (a bounded track, not a column count); moves into a drawer below desktop
the table takes the remaining space and scrolls locally when it needs more
